entities.summary: Michał Jerzy Winiarski is a Polish professional volleyball coach and former player. Winiarski was a member of the Poland national team from 2004 to 2014, a participant in the Olympic Games, 2014 World Champion, and the 2012 World League winner. He serves as head coach for the Polish PlusLiga team, Aluron CMC Warta Zawiercie.
